about_the_game:
Before the job, there was a nightmare.

This demo introduces the prologue of Maguntsche: Chapter Two, plunging you into the fractured mind of Andrew Allen before he ever sets foot in the Lockridge Shipping Company. A dream of a forgotten childhood home becomes a maze of warped memories and hostile premonitions, setting the stage for a horror that has been waiting for him his entire life.

In this Prologue Demo, you will:

  • Explore a waking nightmare: Navigate the distorted corridors of Andrew's childhood home as it's twisted by an otherworldly influence, blurring the line between memory and reality.

  • Survive an introductory encounter: Flee from an entity that has haunted your steps from the dream world into reality.

  • Experience the Dark Descent: Get your first taste of the Realmverse. To escape its maze-like corridors, you must find and collect scattered Reality Fragments before you are consumed.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12

  • OS: Windows 11

short_description: Navigate the distorted corridors of a childhood home as it's twisted by an otherworldly influence, blurring the line between memory and reality. In this free demo, play through "The Prologue" Act and evade the Maguntsche Demon to wake yourself up from this "nightmare".
